title: I hate this place
content: The dreams I’ve had of mall world range from long hallways where the corner room is a 1960s style diner, that atrium in a forgotten wing with the huge windows and the musty air, the massive commercial kitchen behind the empty arcade, the crumbling 1920s style movie theater that’s almost open air due to the decay (and sincerely fuck all the creepy silhouette people sitting in the front rows). I want out. I’ve had enough of this place. I’m tired of dreaming about it. It’s ill. It’s a foul place.
